title: Reliance Q1 Results Preview: O2C, Jio to drive earnings - Key things to watch out for
summary: Reliance Industries is set to announce Q1 FY27 results on July 17, with expectations of consolidated growth. The O2C segment is likely to recover, while retail performance remains mixed amid subdued consumer demand.
